config.script:
system.perspective.openPopup(
		'styles-template-switcher',
		'Appearance/Switcher',
		# THIS REPO'S OWN VIEW, generated by scripts/gen-themes.py. It was
		# upstream's inherited switcher until the themes cutover; the comment
		# that used to sit here still said so, and said the size came from
		# upstream's own min() sizing, months after both stopped being true.
		#
		# It writes session.custom.styleOverride rather than
		# session.custom.style, because style is BOUND (it prefers the override,
		# else the committed theme, on a 5s poll) and a bound property swallows
		# a write in silence. Committing to every project -- the only form that
		# travels over EAM -- is the separate 'Apply everywhere' button.
		#
		# SIZE COMES FROM THE VIEW'S OWN props.defaultSize (560x460), not from
		# here. openPopup HAS NO width OR height ARGUMENT -- see
		# gen-themes.py:gen_switcher for the reflection and the measurements.
		# Unknown kwargs are swallowed in silence, so a size passed here reads
		# as working and does nothing at all. A per-call override is
		# position={'width': N, 'height': N} -- integers, pixels, no CSS.
		title='Theme',
		modal=True,
		draggable=True,
		resizable=False,
		overlayDismiss=True,
		viewportBound=True)
